test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 11 Dec, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
A, B, C, D, W, X and Y are sitting around a circular table facing the centre of the table.

C sits to the immediate left of B. W sits to the immediate left of A. A sits second to the left of X. D sits third to the left of B. Who sits third to the right of Y?
solution:
**Given: **A, B, C, D, W, X and Y are sitting around a circular table facing the centre of the table.

1. C sits to the immediate left of B.

2. D sits third to the left of B.

3. W sits to the immediate left of A.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/47944e76329ed096a4c2438a06ea710075f4566f615c18f87c56d81ec406a6cd.png] 

4. A sits second to the left of X.

The above statement cannot be satisfied in case II, so it is eliminated.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/603629dbf5101eaf0cd16f2b28443b597c7954c7e1e78b2779b5cc041ccc7dfd.png] 

Y, the only person left will occupy the vacant position.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/70b58aa7c5c4ca725ba866498c6bdffaa50d522c22f5f5bad9f91a89dabac7c9.png] 

Thus, D sits third to the right of Y.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
